description:
In Sprint for Survival, there’s no time to ask questions. You wake up in the dark, the forest is alive, and they’re already coming. Your only option? Move forward. Don’t stop. Don’t think.

Dodge, shoot, heal, repeat. Every step is earned, every meter counts, and every shadow hides something worse than the last.

You won't survive forever — but you might just survive a little longer.
name: Sprint for Survival
intro: Run like your life depends on it — because it does.
